item: English voiceover & subtitle required (other languages will not be accepted)
Brand name and product name must be spelled accurately (Exacty AGE20'S)
Need to dramatically crack/break the sun-shaped PR package
Need to reveal both sunscreen products inside the package
Need to show both sunscreens side-by-side: Yellow (UV Defense Hydro Calming) vs Purple (UV Mineral Priming)
Need to apply both sunscreens — half-face or texture close-up — showing smooth spreadability
Need to show split-face or split-screen comparison of both finishes
Need to include a clear Before & After comparison
Need to include CTA overlay: Available on Amazon
Need to highlight lightweight texture and no white residue / no chalkiness on both sunscreens
Need to tag @age20s_global as Tag Person
Need to put on required hashtag : #AmazonPrimeDay #BreaktheSunChallenge #AGE20SSunscreen #KSunScreen #SPFMAX
